findings.message: Multiple root-level HTML files with data-composition-id: index.html, proxy.html. The runtime may discover both as entry points, causing duplicate audio playback.
findings.fixHint: A project should have exactly one root index.html with data-composition-id. Remove or rename extra files.

findings.message: <video id="mg2-b01"> has data-start="0.72" inside a sub-composition. Nested media timing is local to its composition by default; a nonzero value can be confused with a legacy root-global timestamp.
findings.fixHint: Keep data-start="0.72" if it is composition-local. If this is a legacy root-global timestamp, add data-hf-media-start-basis="global"; otherwise convert it to local time by subtracting the host start.

findings.message: Timeline callback reaches DOM measurement (getBoundingClientRect/getTotalLength/getComputedStyle/...). The renderer seeks with suppressEvents=false, so callbacks re-fire on every seek, and a cold render worker runs them against whatever DOM state its own non-linear seek order produced. Measured geometry is seek-order-dependent, and values measured at build time (before the callback ran) are stale or zero.
findings.fixHint: Do all measurement and DOM setup synchronously at build time, before registering the timeline, or derive geometry from fixed composition coordinates instead of measuring.

findings.message: This HTML composition file has 413 lines. Smaller sub-compositions are easier to read, iterate on, and diff.
findings.fixHint: Split this sub-composition further into smaller .html files, then mount them from the parent with data-composition-src so each file stays small enough to inspect, revise, and validate independently.
